claim: The two locked readings OD-241 (OPEN-DECISIONS.md:328) sets side by side both hold on main: ADR 0145's ROLE_POLICY reads admin as the owner row (ROLE_POLICY_ALIASES), and ADR 0164's RolesGuard admits only a role the route lists, by exact match, so it refuses admin on a route that does not name it. It pins the two readings as they stand, not a wanted state: whoever rules on OD-241 changes this row with the ruling.

claim: OD-241 (OPEN-DECISIONS.md:328) says no route can receive admin today. A route's role is the person's access row in the house the token names, never users.role (jwt.strategy.ts, auth.service.ts), and that row's role is owner, manager or staff only, by user_restaurant_access_role_known, which one migration defines and no other drops. Whoever lets a role reach a route from elsewhere, or changes the constraint, changes this row and OD-241.

(user.house_role ?? null) : null;' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/strategies/jwt.strategy.ts && grep -qF 'house_role: roleInHouse(houseAccess.data),' apps/api-gateway/src/auth/auth.service.ts && grep -qF "CHECK (role IN ('owner', 'manager', 'staff'))" supabase/migrations/20260902200000_team_access_role_is_a_known_role.sql && !
